connector.name: MCP by openagentemail
connector.registryDescription: Unlimited agent mailboxes - create identities, read/wait for mail, extract OTPs, send email.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the openagentemail account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAGENTEMAIL_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer key for the openagent.email API — best: the identity token (oa_…) returned by POST /v1/identities.

env.name: OPENAGENTEMAIL_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the openagent.email API.
